name: peer-pair-release
description: This role's jar (A) and a pinned ergoplatform/ergo release jar (B) on one two-node network, bring-up gate off. First the release jar parses the sync-info payloads this jar writes (V2, and V3 if present); then, after PP_WAIT_S of their own syncing, does each node list the other as connected, and did either fail to parse the other's messages or blacklist it?
